meta: Schedule work shifts fairly with AI: scheduling in a group chat easily turns into arguments; AI gives you a fair draft.

muc.title: Shifts turn into arguments
muc.text: Scheduling in a group chat easily turns into arguments: someone always gets nights, someone else is short on hours. AI gives you a fair draft.

muc.title: Give it everything
muc.text: Give the chatbot opening hours, how many people per shift, and each person's availability, using nicknames.

muc.title: Set rules for the schedule
muc.text: Add rules like at most three night shifts per person per week, weekends shared evenly, and no back-to-back shifts.

muc.title: Review before finalizing
muc.text: AI often miscounts hours, so recheck each person's total, then share the draft for everyone's input.

muc.title: A one-week schedule
muc.text: Enter the availability of three imaginary people, ask a chatbot for a one-week schedule, then recount the hours yourself.
